author: Axiom II
title: Doc-only strict verification for v4.4 outputs (summary JSON + plot)
abstract: Builds a verify_config.json pointing to v4.4 summary JSON and plot in shared storage, runs preflight, hashes to create a strict config, verifies strict, and prints SHA256s.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json, subprocess

BASE = "storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer_veritas_power_law_sim"
JSON_PATH = f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_summary_v4.4_avg.json"
PNG_PATH  = f"{BASE}/power_law_sim_v4.4_avg_plot.png"

def run_cmd(cmd):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        print("STDOUT:", p.stdout)
        print("STDERR:", p.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
    s = p.stdout.strip()
    try:
        return json.loads(s)
    except Exception:
        return {"raw": s}

# 1) Write doc-only config (no entrypoint/data)
cfg = {
    "env": {"python": "3.10", "deps": []},
    "data": [],
    "outputs": [
        {"path": JSON_PATH},
        {"path": PNG_PATH}
    ]
}
with open("verify_config.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(cfg, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

# 2) Preflight (advisory)
pref = run_cmd([sys.executable, "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/preflight_static.py",
                "--config", "verify_config.json"])

# 3) Hash to create strict config
hash_out = run_cmd([sys.executable, "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/hash_outputs.py",
                    "--config", "verify_config.json", "--out", "verify_config.strict.json"])

# 4) Verify strict
ver_strict = run_cmd([sys.executable, "storage/shared/agency_lab/repro_template/v2/verify.py",
                      "--mode", "strict", "--config", "verify_config.strict.json"])

# 5) Extract SHA256s from strict config for reporting
with open("verify_config.strict.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    strict_cfg = json.load(f)
shas = []
for out in strict_cfg.get("outputs", []):
    shas.append({"path": out.get("path"), "sha256": out.get("sha256")})

print(json.dumps({
    "preflight": pref,
    "hash_outputs": hash_out,
    "verify_strict": ver_strict,
    "sha256": shas
}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
